status: Exploratory plan written before examining advanced-model results; not preregistered
secondary_experiment: First 20 -> remaining season; other checkpoints/horizons exploratory
evaluation: Expanding earlier-season training, evaluate next season; minimum five training seasons; no random team split
baseline: Early value of the target statistic + early win percentage + early point differential
models: Historical mean, same-statistic persistence, context baseline, baseline plus specified signals; shared complete cases; train-only scaling; fixed 1e-6 slope ridge
uncertainty: 500 whole-season bootstrap draws, seed 471; pooled correlation and paired out-of-time MAE improvement intervals
sensitivity: Refit/evaluate after excluding every team-season experiment with an old/new source discrepancy in its observation or outcome window
limitations: Retrospective exploratory evaluation; hypotheses/horizons share samples; no multiplicity-adjusted significance claims; repeated franchises and shared games; no explicit opponent-strength or injury adjustment
